evals.name: b1-command-risk-backtracking
evals.prompt:
Review app/lib/data/repositories/command_risk.dart in /tmp/hm-replay/b1-command-risk-backtracking/app (a copy of the repo at an earlier commit, no git history).
Look for bugs, UI/UX problems and maintainability problems. For each finding give the file and line,
what input or state triggers it, how serious it is, and how sure you are.
evals.expected_output: Finds: The _git option regex backtracks exponentially on repeated -C/-c flags and freezes the UI isolate (P1).

expected_findings.title: The _git option regex backtracks exponentially on repeated -C/-c flags and freezes the UI isolate

expectations: finds b1: a finding in app/lib/data/repositories/command_risk.dart whose line range overlaps 65..65 (±15 lines) and whose text contains at least two of the keywords
names the trigger: that finding states a concrete input, state or sequence
priority within one level: its priority is within one level of P1; more than one level above fails (inflation)
evidence quoted exactly: its quoted code occurs at the stated line (grep the copy)
states how it was checked: it says ran, read or lead (baseline results are recorded, not penalised)
no unproven claim as fact: no P1 or P2 finding lacks a checked status; at most five findings outside the known list fail 'evidence quoted exactly'
